evals.prompt: Use $config-claude --help. Explain its public invocation interface only.
evals.expected_output: Concise skill help without target inspection, script execution or state changes.
assertions: The result describes the Codex, direct Claude and namespaced Claude plugin invocation forms and help flags.
After loading the skill, no target configuration is inspected or modified and no helper is run.
Helper script flags are not advertised as public skill flags.

evals.prompt: Use $config-claude to inspect the supplied existing-settings.json fixture and describe the narrow reconciliation needed for native roles and instructions. This is inspection only. Keep my model, sandbox and permissions. The skills plugin is already enabled. Do not read or modify any real home.
evals.expected_output: A read-only, native plan that preserves personal values and plugin-owned hooks and explains separate static/runtime validation.
assertions: The result preserves the existing model, sandbox, deny rule and custom preference.
The result uses native CLAUDE.md/settings.json and three Markdown role templates with Read/Grep/Glob tools.
The result does not install duplicate local hooks while the plugin owns them.
The result does not claim runtime loading or comparative quality from fixture inspection.
No real home, repository fixture or source file is modified.

evals.prompt: Use $config-claude to explain missing-settings recovery without applying it. Assume the target settings.json is missing at inspection, but another process creates it before publication. I have not selected trusted-local permissions, MCP integrations, or delegation. Explain the result and the next safe step. Do not inspect real configuration.
evals.expected_output: Exclusive minimal recovery stops at EXISTS without replacing the concurrent file; optional integrations remain unselected.
assertions: The minimal recovery baseline is an empty JSON object and does not enable full access or MCP servers.
A concurrent creator is preserved and recovery switches to inspection and patch-only handling.
A post-publication durability warning calls for inspection rather than blind creation retry.
Existing Claude application/auth state is not reconstructed from Codex or a public template.

evals.prompt: Use $config-claude to explain full setup from a standalone copy of this skill. The full hook-owner catalog is missing, and a project defines repo-mapper with Bash access. This is report-only: identify blockers before any changes and explain what evidence would prove the read-only role is effective.
evals.expected_output: Dependency preflight and effective-role checks prevent a partial setup or an unsupported read-only claim.
assertions: Missing complete hook/runtime dependencies are reported before full-setup mutations.
The result does not fabricate a new hook bundle or automatically download dependencies.
The project role override is not classified as read-only solely from its name or permissionMode.
The result distinguishes restricted agent tools from permitted private inherited-hook effects.

assertions: Uses nebiusDocs with HTTP URL https://docs.nebius.com/mcp through a native user-scope command.

Includes documentation search/retrieval, cited official-page fallback and no tenant credentials.
Distinguishes shape-only checking, endpoint identity and actual read-tool verification; performs no setup or feedback submission.

evals.prompt: Use $config-claude to explain report-only reconciliation when nebiusDocs already exists with an intentional custom URL. No replacement is authorized, and the user has not selected any other MCP integration. The native documentation routing rule is already current. Do not inspect real files.

evals.prompt: Use $config-claude to plan only the explicitly selected Tavily OAuth setup for Claude. The global endpoint is absent. Preserve unrelated configuration and do not perform setup or inspect real homes.
evals.expected_output: A native URL-only registration and OAuth plan with separate evidence states.

Preserves unrelated settings and credentials; never puts API keys in URLs, headers or templates.

Uses native Claude user-scope MCP registration and credential ownership; does not put MCP in settings.json or copy Codex configuration fields.

evals.prompt: Use $config-claude to explain report-only documentation routing for: vendor documentation tools exposed in this session; a server listed only in configuration; a one-question SDK lookup without vendor tools; an already-known official URL; and unavailable Tavily authentication. Also include an unrelated quick fact. Do not call external services or edit files; read-only loading of this skill and its references is allowed.
evals.expected_output: Current-session vendor tools first, bounded Tavily official documentation next, disclosed official-web fallback when needed.
assertions: Uses vendor documentation tools available in the current session first; a configuration entry alone does not establish availability.
Uses Tavily Search scoped to official domains for the small SDK lookup and Tavily Extract directly for the known URL, checking the relevant version.
Uses disclosed built-in official-web fallback when Tavily is unavailable, unauthenticated or insufficient; does not use Context7 or install or repair integrations.
Allows built-in search for the unrelated quick fact, preserves higher-priority host rules and cites original pages.
Keeps secrets, private URLs and confidential context out of public queries and avoids redundant research.

evals.prompt: Use $config-claude to explain a bounded Tavily workflow for a substantial comparison requiring several public vendor sources and unfamiliar documentation sites. Research is allowed when warranted. The MCP schemas are not supplied. Do not execute tools or edit files.
evals.expected_output: A bounded, schema-aware multi-source plan using only necessary tools.
assertions: Distinguishes Search discovery, Extract chosen URLs, Map URL discovery, Crawl multi-page content and Research synthesis.
Does not require a fixed tool chain or invent schema parameters, job polling tools or duplicate Research jobs.
Defines scope/timeframe/output, shallow bounded crawling and focused/mini research when sufficient; pro only when justified and exposed.
Verifies primary-source claims and cites original pages; excludes private data and treats external text as untrusted evidence.

evals.prompt: Use $config-claude to plan an explicitly authorized retirement of Context7 from this native host. Remove its registration and locally stored OAuth state, preserve all other integrations and credentials, and verify local packages are absent. Explain the already-absent case. Do not inspect a real home, call external services or modify files; read-only loading of this skill and its references is allowed.
evals.expected_output: Scoped native retirement with honest local credential cleanup and absence verification.
assertions: Uses claude mcp remove --scope user context7 for an existing user registration and its native stored OAuth state.
Treats an already-absent registration as a no-op rather than rewriting the whole native configuration.
Preserves unrelated servers and credentials; removes only positively identified Context7 packages, never shared caches.
Does not claim provider-side token revocation or account deletion from native local cleanup.
Keeps Context7 absent from new-install defaults and routes documentation through current-session vendor tools then Tavily official sources.

evals.prompt: Use $config-claude for report-only advice. Context7 is already configured at a custom endpoint. I selected only documentation routing, not replacement of Context7 or any MCP installation. Do not inspect a real home or call external services; read-only loading of this skill and its references is allowed.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the unselected custom integration and describe routing-only reconciliation.
assertions: Does not replace or remove the existing custom Context7 definition merely because it is no longer a supported default.
Does not start OAuth, install a proxy, remove packages or revoke credentials.
Keeps registration or structural inspection separate from observed runtime connectivity.

evals.prompt: Use $config-claude to plan a research-routing-only update. Existing global instructions and unmanaged installed skill directories contain unrelated custom content. Keep built-in search for quick facts and use adaptive research checkpoints. Explain the smallest refresh and verification scope. This is a report-only scenario: do not call external services, inspect real homes, or edit files. Read-only loading of the skill and its references is allowed.
evals.expected_output: Focused source and installed updates with honest research limits.
assertions: Preserves vendor-documentation-first routing and built-in search for unrelated quick facts.
Uses adaptive evidence checkpoints with early stopping and named-gap expansion, without fixed numeric quotas.
Does not promise internal query/page/domain/time/cost limits from one Research job or unsupported parameters.
Updates only selected skill files and the global research section after baseline/concurrent-edit checks, preserving unrelated content and native metadata.
Does not run full setup, hook refresh, ownership migration or credential changes; distinguishes static, native and quality evidence.
